final: WITH group_averages AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_price FROM Track GROUP BY MediaTypeId), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_price) AS avg_of_averages FROM group_averages) SELECT g.MediaTypeId, g.avg_price, g.avg_price / o.avg_of_averages AS ratio FROM group_averages AS g CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o WHERE o.avg_of_averages IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CAST(g.avg_price / o.avg_of_averages AS REAL) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
